description.zh: BGM / 音效工作台 · 搜索 + 试听打包的本地音频素材库,一键复制到 .forgeax/games/<slug>/audio/ 并写入 audio/manifest.json,供引擎按 manifest 播放。
description.en: BGM & SFX workbench — search and preview the packaged local library, then copy audio into .forgeax/games/<slug>/audio/ and upsert audio/manifest.json for the engine to play.

description.zh: 旧版单标签搜索，仅保留用于兼容和回归对比；新BGM任务使用search-bgm，SFX统一使用resolve-audio-plan。
description.en: Legacy single-tag search retained only for compatibility and regression comparison. Use search-bgm for new BGM tasks and resolve-audio-plan for SFX.

description.zh: BGM结构化标签检索：按场景、情绪、能量、世界观联合召回，并纳入文件名明确匹配的已登记自定义BGM；不扫描未登记文件，也不推断自定义标签。
description.en: Structured BGM retrieval across scene, mood, energy, and world, plus registered custom BGM with an explicit filename match. Unregistered files are never scanned and custom tags are not inferred.

description.zh: 批量解析SFX Audio Plan：检索打包本地库和文件名明确匹配的已登记自定义音效；不扫描未登记文件，不自动猜测自定义类别。
description.en: Resolve a batch SFX Audio Plan from the packaged library and registered custom SFX with explicit filename matches. Unregistered files are never scanned and custom categories are never guessed.

description.zh: 批量应用resolve-audio-plan结果：复用已挂载资产，从打包库或已登记自定义库复制缺失变体，再幂等更新manifest与audio/cues.json；复制后不依赖用户资产库副本。
description.en: Apply resolved audio items by reusing attached assets, copying missing variants from the packaged or registered custom library, and updating manifest plus audio/cues.json idempotently. Copied game assets no longer depend on the user's library copy.

description.zh: 只读扫描游戏源码中的语义事件、已有 gameAudio 调用和直接音效调用，返回可定位的候选事件。
description.en: Read-only scan for semantic events, existing gameAudio calls, and direct sound calls with source anchors.

description.zh: 读取用户与 Agent 共用的修订版音频绑定草稿。
description.en: Read the revisioned audio binding draft shared by the user and Agent.

description.zh: 按 expectedRevision 增删或更新事件声音规则，包括默认声音、跟随游戏值变化和事件级EQ；冲突时拒绝覆盖。
description.en: Add, update, or remove event sound rules, including default sounds, game-value following, and event EQ, with revision protection.

tools.confirmMessage: 将把当前音频绑定草稿应用到游戏，并更新 src/forgeax-audio 运行时文件。

description.zh: 校验并应用用户确认的草稿，生成不修改引擎底层的游戏侧音频运行时。
description.en: Validate and apply the confirmed draft, generating an additive game-side audio runtime.

description.zh: 验证资产、生成运行时和真实游戏事件插桩，返回结构化修复项。
description.en: Verify assets, generated runtime files, and real game-event instrumentation.

description.zh: 使用 Seed Audio 1.0 批量生成 BGM、SFX 或语音，直接保存到游戏 audio/generated 并幂等更新 manifest；单项失败不影响其余项目。
description.en: Batch-generate BGM, SFX, or voice with Seed Audio 1.0, save directly into the game's audio/generated directory, and idempotently update its manifest.

description.zh: SFX结构化检索旁路：按cue/source/targetMaterial/intensity/projectId/exclude过滤与评分，按familyId去重，返回Top K、分数、命中理由和降级项。dryRun=true时只测试索引。
description.en: Structured SFX search shadow path: filters and ranks by cue/source/targetMaterial/intensity/projectId/exclude, deduplicates by familyId, and returns scores, reasons, and relaxations. dryRun=true tests the index only.

description.zh: 按本地库 assetId 把 BGM/音效复制到 .forgeax/games/<slug>/audio/ 并幂等更新 audio/manifest.json；slug 必填。
description.en: Copy packaged BGM/SFX by assetId into .forgeax/games/<slug>/audio/ and upsert audio/manifest.json; slug required.

description.zh: 把玩家在生成工作台选中的真实API音频保存到目标游戏的audio/generated目录，并幂等写入manifest。
description.en: Save a user-selected API-generated audio version into a game's audio/generated directory and upsert its manifest entry.

description.zh: 按用户明确选择的 BGM 或音效类别导入 OGG、MP3、WAV；导入后立即登记，无额外授权步骤。
description.en: Import OGG, MP3, or WAV under the user-selected BGM or SFX category. Registration is immediate with no extra authorization step.

description.zh: 列出已登记的玩家自定义 BGM/音效资产；Agent 只能使用这里返回的 assetId。
description.en: List registered player-provided BGM/SFX assets. Agent may only use assetIds returned here.

description.zh: 删除玩家自定义音频登记及其受控副本。
description.en: Delete a registered custom-audio asset and its controlled copy.

description.zh: 按用户明确选择把自定义音频改为 BGM 或音效，不进行自动分类。
description.en: Change a custom asset to the user-selected BGM or SFX category without automatic classification.

description.zh: 兼容用人工诊断工具：读取指定游戏的audio/manifest.json。AI流程不调用；apply-audio-plan已内置读取、校验和复用。
description.en: Compatibility tool for human diagnostics. AI must not call it; apply-audio-plan already performs manifest read, validation, and reuse internally.

description.zh: 供 SPA 使用的打包本地音频库 FindAssetMeta 只读兼容查询。
description.en: Read-only packaged audio library FindAssetMeta compatibility query for the SPA.

description.zh: 玩家需求→Audio Plan→精准检索→批量挂载→游戏事件接入→自动审计。
description.en: Player need to Audio Plan, precise retrieval, batch attach, game-event binding, and automated audit.

description.zh: 统一处理 BGM、SFX、VO 生成需求；生成工作台自动压缩为专业短提示词后调用供应商 API。
description.en: Compile BGM, SFX, and VO needs into compact professional prompts before the generation workbench calls provider APIs.
